title: A name
body: Louma is Milla's sister. The bakery carries her name and, with it, a promise about who it's for.

title: An idea
body: Build a real bakery — high standards, honest bread — and staff it in a way most places say can't be done.

title: A team
body: Bakers and trainers, many with intellectual or developmental differences, learning the craft together.

title: A corner on Wilshire
body: A small room, a big oven, and a door with a face on it. Opening July 2026.
